Rooms
Click a room's name to rename it — use the real tenancy or area name and it carries through to the plan and the report.
No rooms yet — hit 🏠 Rooms above: click two corners on empty space to create one, as many as you wish, at any point in the process. Click a room to select and drag; click a corner to pick it up and click to drop; click an edge to add a corner. Boundaries act as walls (toggle under Display). The report breaks fittings and power down per room.
Furniture
Desks, screens and racking block light and bounce it. Height is what decides whether a block shadows anything: a 0.72 m desk under a 0.75 m work plane shadows nothing, a 1.4 m screen shadows a great deal.

Exclude 0.5 m perimeter
AS/NZS 1680.4 defines the maintained-illuminance reference surface as the working plane EXCLUDING a 0.5 m perimeter strip. AGi32 reports over whatever polygon it was given, so leave this off when cross-checking a designer's figures and on when quoting against the standard.
Assessment grid (m)
Compliance figures (avg / min / U₀) are quoted on a cell-centred grid at this spacing — the convention AGi32/DIALux report on. The heat map still uses the finer calculation grid. Match a reference report's spacing when cross-checking.
Ceiling ρ
Wall ρ
Floor ρ
Avg ceiling ht (m)
Inter-reflection
Inter-reflected (bounced) light per the average-reflectance flux method — lifts corners and uniformity toward a radiosity result. Reflectances default to the common 0.7/0.5/0.2. Turn off for a purely direct, conservative check.

3D light plot in PDF report
Adds an isometric view of every room you have created — walls to ceiling height, fittings at their mounting height, and the light falling on each floor — to the exported PDF report.
Heatmap scale
Peak scaling colours the plot by the brightest point, so stronger fittings visibly shine brighter and further. Switch to 1.5× target for a compliance-oriented view.

Default target
Default target applied to newly drawn rooms. Set each room's own target in the Rooms panel.
J7 allowance override (W/m²)
Lux presets are indicative only — verify against AS/NZS 1680.2 / project spec. The NCC J7 power density allowance is set automatically per room from its type (NCC 2022 Table J7D3a); the override box is for a project-specific figure only.
Find fittings
Toolbar above the plan: 📏 Calibrate · ⛶ Set plot area · 🏠 Rooms · 📐 Measure · 🔎 Find fittings, plus the clear buttons. Find fittings: box ONE example (symbol + its label, e.g. a B3 with its text) — on PDFs the exact label is searched (B3 ≠ B3E) and confirmed against the symbol.
Start fresh
Wipes the drawing, fittings, rooms, measurements and project details, and returns to the start screen. Save first if you want to keep this design.
SCALE NOT SET match % 100%

Hold Shift while placing or dragging to snap fittings into straight rows and columns (aligns to other fittings, or to a 0.5 m grid when nothing is nearby). Point-by-point calculation (cos^m distribution from beam angle, inverse-square law, maintenance factor applied). When the Inter-reflection option is on (the default) an approximate bounced component is added, which raises results above a purely direct calc — turn it off for a conservative, direct-only check. Indicative design check only; verify final compliance with certified photometric (IES) files in AGi32/DIALux or via the project's electrical engineer.
